fields.schemeName: Assistance For Purchase Of Spectacles By A Differently Abled Person
fields.briefDescription: The "Assistance for Purchase of Spectacles by A Differently Abled Persons" scheme in Tamil Nadu is a government initiative that aims to provide financial assistance to differently-abled individuals.

fields.schemeName: Travel Concession To The Differently Abled Persons In State Owned Transport Corporation Buses
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Tamil Nadu introduced Differently Abled Persons In Stated Owned Tranportat Corporation buses.

fields.schemeName: Mandahasam Scheme To Provide Artificial Dentures To Senior Citizens
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Mandahasam Scheme to Provide Artificial Dentures to Senior Citizens” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Aawasiye Bhu-Adhikaar Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Revenue Department of Madhya Pradesh State started this scheme to provide residential plots.

fields.schemeName: Laadli Laxmi Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Laadli Laxmi Scheme was launched with the intention to address the undesirable tendency of female foeticides and with an aim towards erasing the general perception that the birth of a girl in the family is a burden on her parents/guardian during her marriage.

fields.schemeName: Ladli Laxmi Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Ladli Lakshmi Yojana has been started in Madhya Pradesh for Girl Child in 2007.

fields.schemeName: Mangalya Scheme For Widow Remarriage
fields.briefDescription: The “Mangalya Scheme” was launched by the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Kerala. Under the scheme, financial assistance is to be provided to eligible widows and divorced women for their remarriage.

fields.schemeName: Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme For Seafarers
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme for Seafarers" by the Home Department, Government of Goa, provides financial assistance in the form of a Gross Pension of ₹ 2,500/- per month to the beneficiaries. The applicant should be a retired seaman. The age of the applicant should be 60 years or above.

fields.schemeName: Disabled Person Pension Scheme - Punjab
fields.briefDescription: Punjab State Government started a pension for disable person of the state.

fields.schemeName: Msme Skill Training And Employment Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “MSME Skill Training and Employment Scheme” was launched by the Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of Tamil Nadu during the years 2021-22.

fields.schemeName: Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme (AABCS)” was launched by the Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of Tamil Nadu.

fields.schemeName: Kisan Samriddhi Yojana - Chhattisgarh
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Kisan Samriddhi Yojana" for farmer.

fields.schemeName: Dai Didi Mobile Clinic Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Government of Chhattisgarh state, started a scheme named "Dai Didi Clinic Scheme" in 2020.

fields.schemeName: Short Term Loan Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Short Term Loan Scheme" provides financial assistance/ loan as a credit to individuals from the Scheduled Tribe Community to meet the immediate expenses towards Education, Medical and Business needs. The scheme aims to improve their standard of living.

fields.schemeName: Self Employment Scheme - Goa
fields.briefDescription: "Self Employment Scheme" provides financial support up to a maximum of ₹ 10,00,000 to any individual person belonging to Scheduled Tribes Community to undertake any self-employment activities.

fields.schemeName: Unemployment Allowance for the Educated Unemployed Youth Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was introduced on 01.11.1988 which provides monthly unemployment allowance to the educated unemployed youth registered with the Employment Exchanges in Haryana.

fields.schemeName: Thalolam Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Kerala launched the “Thalolam Scheme” under Kerala Social Security Mission to provide free treatment to children affected with chronic diseases such as haemophilia, cerebral palsy, etc.

fields.schemeName: Young Investigators Programme in Biotechnology
fields.briefDescription: The programme “Young Investigator’s Programme in Biotechnology (YIPB)” is a research support programme that aims to provide quick research support to young researchers to pursue their ideas in newly emerging and front-line areas of research in Biotechnology.

fields.schemeName: Kala Samman Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Kala Samman Scheme" grants financial assistance to eminent artists who are in indigent circumstances as a token of respect for their contribution to the field of Art and culture.

fields.schemeName: Kerala State Young Scientist Awards
fields.briefDescription: The “Kerala State Young Scientist Awards” by the KSCSTE are intended to honour talented young Scientists in recognition of their outstanding contributions in any branch of science and technology coming within the purview of the Council.

fields.schemeName: Vishvakarma Durghatana Mrtyu par Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Raashi Bhugataan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh state Government started a scheme "Vishvakarma Durghatana Mrtyu Par Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Raashi Bhugataan Yojana" for labor workers.

fields.schemeName: DEVELOPMENT OF HANDICRAFTS
fields.briefDescription: The government of Puducherry takes the initiative to revive the vanishing crafts and restore the significance of traditional crafts.

fields.schemeName: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to the Publishers for Publishing Books of Goan Authors
fields.briefDescription: "Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to the Publishers for Publishing Books of Goan Authors"  by the Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Goa, has been designed to promote Goan publishers to provide them with financial support for the publication of books.

fields.schemeName: Barbershop Renovation Grant
fields.briefDescription: The “Barbershop Renovation Grant” scheme is launched by the Backward Communities Development Department, Government of Kerala. Under the scheme, financial assistance will be provided to the traditional barber of rural areas to uplift the standard of the traditional barbershops.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Avivahita Pension Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Madhya Pradesh State Government started the "Mukhyamantri Avivahita Pension Yojana" for unmarried women of the state.

fields.schemeName: Futkar Sabji, Phal-Phool Vikreta Hetu Taraju, Baat Evan Tokari Sahaayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Futkar Sabji, Phal-Phool Vikreta Hetu Taraju, Baat Evan Tokari Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 15 June 2016.

fields.schemeName: Silicosis (Bimari) Se Pidit Shramiko Ke Liye Aarthik Evam Punarvas Sahayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh state Government started a scheme "Silicosis (Bimari) Se Pidit Shramiko Ke Liye Aarthik Evam Punarvas Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 16 January 2018.

fields.schemeName: E-Rikshaw Sahayta Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "E-Rikshaw Sahayta Yojana" for unorganized worker in 20 December 2016.

fields.schemeName: National Scheme of Apprenticeship Training
fields.briefDescription: The primary goal of this scheme is to bridge the gap in practical experience for fresh Graduate Engineers, Diploma holders, and 10+2 Vocational pass-outs in approximately 10,000 industrial establishments. The apprentices undergo a one-year training period, receiving a monthly stipend.

fields.schemeName: Mahila Kamgar Kaushal Unnayan Evan Theka Shramik, Hamaal Tatha Ghareloo Mahila Kamgaar Parivar Sashaktikaran Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mahila Kamgar Kaushal Unnayan Evan Theka Shramik, Hamaal Tatha Ghareloo Mahila Kamgaar Parivar Sashaktikaran Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

fields.schemeName: Award of Opportunity Cost to Parents of Scheduled Caste Girl Students
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to financially assist the SC parents for sending school their daughters who otherwise earn livelihood for the family engaging themselves in menial labour.

fields.schemeName: Stipend to Scheduled Caste Trainees in Technical Training Institutions
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial support to Scheduled Tribe candidates/trainees who are undergoing training in the Government Technical Training Institutions of the Union Territory of Puducherry.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Fishermen For Purchase of Fisheries Requisites (Gill Net/ River Gill Net with Accessories)
fields.briefDescription: “Financial Assistance To Fishermen For Purchase of Fisheries Requisites” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. Through this scheme, a 50% subsidy is provided to the fishermen of Goa for the purchase of fisheries requisites (gill nets with accessories).

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Fresh Water Aquaculture Farms
fields.briefDescription: “Financial Assistance to Fresh Water Aquaculture Farms” is a scheme by the Dept. of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible fishermen for the construction and renovation of the Farm, for the purchase of farming equipment, and the purchase of feed.

fields.schemeName: Mukhya Mantri Shahri Ajeevika Guarantee Yojna
fields.briefDescription: The “Mukhya Mantri Shahri Ajeevika Guarantee Yojna” was launched by the Department of Urban Development, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh. The objective of the scheme is to enhance livelihood security in urban areas by providing 120 days of guaranteed wage employment to every household in a financial year.

fields.schemeName: Theka Shramik Evan Hamaal Shramik Baahy Rogi Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Theka Shramik Evan Hamaal Shramik Baahy Rogi Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Take up Value Addition to Seafood
fields.briefDescription: Through this scheme, individuals who have been residents of Goa for the last 15 years, and are interested in setting up a unit for value-added fisheries products are provided financial assistance as a subsidy of 50% of the cost for the Construction or Renovation of the Unit/ Purchase of Equipment.

fields.schemeName: Goa Value Added Tax-Based Subsidy on H.S.D. Oil Consumed by Fishing Vessels Scheme
fields.briefDescription: “Goa Value Added Tax-Based Subsidy on H.S.D. Oil Consumed by Fishing Vessels Scheme” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Through this scheme, the amount equivalent to the actual VAT paid shall be reimbursed to the owner as a subsidy on H.S.D. Oil consumed by the fishing vessel.

fields.schemeName: Natural Calamity Relief to Fishermen of State
fields.briefDescription: “Natural Calamity Relief to Fishermen of State” is a scheme by the Dept of Fisheries, Govt of Goa. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to the active fishermen who contribute to the Fishermen Corpus Relief Fund, whose fishing vessels are damaged or lost due to natural calamities.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Barrier Net and its Accessories
fields.briefDescription: “Financial Assistance for Purchase of Barrier Net and its Accessories” is a scheme by Dept. of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Under this Scheme financial assistance is provided as a subsidy on the purchase of barrier nets and accessories for the fishermen. The applications are accepted offline.

fields.schemeName: ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: The “ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship (AI-RTF)” is a fellowship scheme initiated by the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India under ASEAN-India Science & Technology Development Fund to support young talented researchers/scientists of ASEAN member countries.

fields.schemeName: Interest Subsidy on Loans for Agriculture and Allied Activities
fields.briefDescription: “Interest Subsidy on Loans for Agriculture and Allied Activities” is a scheme by the Dept. of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. The bonafide agriculturist, individual of the animal husbandry/fisheries sector from Goa are provided a loan of upto ₹ 5,00,000 for the purpose of Agriculture and Allied Activities.

fields.schemeName: Certification Program for Goan IT Professionals
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides reimbursement of up to 50% of the expenditure incurred for obtaining certifications for improving their employability. The scheme has been framed as a part of Goa's IT Policy that envisages Goa as an aspirational geographical and human resource base for IT Units.

fields.schemeName: AICTE-QUALITY IMPROVEMENT (FOREIGN UNIVERSITY) PROGRAMME
fields.briefDescription: The All India Council for Technical Education in its 55th Meeting of the Council held on 14th August 2018 approved the Quality Improvement Programme (Foreign University) (QIP-FU). The QIP(FU) is an extension of the QIP program launched by the Government of India in the year 1970.

fields.schemeName: AICTE-Technical Book Writing & Translation Scheme
fields.briefDescription: AICTE-Technical Book Writing & Translation scheme has been launched by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) to promote the use of 'Scheduled Regional Language' in Technical Education for creating knowledge base in local language.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kalakar Sahayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Mukhyamantri Kalakar Sahayata Yojana is a scheme under the Odia Language, Literature & Culture Department, Government of Odisha aims to offer sustenance and assistance to elderly artists who, despite facing financial hardship, have consistently devoted themselves to enriching culture of the state.

fields.schemeName: Government Hostel for Working Women/ Girl Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide suitable, inexpensive, and safe accommodation to women employed in government offices, organizations, and firms, as well as girl students studying in colleges. Essential facilities include a cot with mattress, lockable cupboards, television, newspapers, magazines, etc.

fields.schemeName: KULAVILAKKU
fields.briefDescription: This scheme aims to enhance the nutritional status of Pregnant Women. ₹500/- assistance is provided to eligible beneficiaries during their pregnancies. The scheme is a crucial step towards ensuring the well-being of both mother and child. The benefit will be provided for upto two pregnancies only.

fields.schemeName: Reimbursement/ Spot Exemption of Sales Tax on High-Speed Diesel Oil
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Reimbursement/ Spot Exemption of Sales Tax on High-Speed Diesel Oil" under "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries" introduced to reimburse the sales tax on high-speed diesel oil used by the registered mechanized boat operators.

fields.schemeName: Bed & Breakfast/Homestay Scheme- Punjab
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Bed & Breakfast/Homestay Scheme” is implemented by the Department of Tourism & Cultural Affairs, Government of Punjab with the aim of providing comfortable Bed & Breakfast (BnB)/Home Stay Facilities and supplementing the availability of accommodation across the State.
